query:
SELECT prf_instance,
                  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - MIN(created_at)
                      FILTER (WHERE signature IS NULL AND NOT is_error))::FLOAT8 AS pending,
                  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - MIN(created_at)
                      FILTER (WHERE signature IS NOT NULL AND s3_verified_at IS NULL))::FLOAT8
                      AS not_uploaded
             FROM pads
            GROUP BY prf_instance
